statement: No production code changes; report identifies governing docs, missing foundations, reusable patterns, blockers, and proposed first branch.
Repository paths are exact; no duplicate competing copies; links resolve; docs/01–11 remain unchanged except approved link corrections.
Vision agrees with docs/01; does not expand scope; future Noma ambition is distinguished from pilot obligations.
Codex can identify required docs and commands from one file; instructions prohibit scope invention, direct status edits, provider truth fabrication, and test deferral.
A clean machine can reach the documented development state without production credentials or tribal knowledge.
Templates fail review if scope source, risk, tests, or intentionally inactive branches are missing.
Every P0 task can be traced forward and backward; unknown references fail validation.
No secret or personal data is permitted in evidence; evidence artefacts have commit, environment, owner, date, and expiry fields.
Workspace builds from clean install; package boundaries match Part 6; no browser package imports server/database internals.
Web/API/Worker start independently; readiness/liveness are distinct; no provider secrets in Web bundle.
Missing production-critical values fail startup safely; logs redact secrets; preview cannot load production credentials.
Real PostgreSQL starts locally/CI; migrations upgrade empty and prior schema; unsafe reset is impossible in production.
Committed outbox work survives API crash; duplicate dispatch is harmless; dead jobs remain visible and owned.
Tests run without production data or credentials; time/randomness/provider outcomes are controllable; cleanup preserves append-only semantics.
Domain/application modules import ports only; simulators reproduce success, timeout, duplicate, reversal, out-of-order, and unknown outcomes.
Protected branch cannot merge on failed required checks; P0 flaky tests remain failures; evidence identifies commit/environment.
Preview/staging never use production database, queue, buckets, keys, or provider recipients; rollback path is documented.
One synthetic request can be traced Web→API→DB/outbox→Worker; sensitive fields are absent; dependency failure changes readiness honestly.
No feature hardcodes status colours; semantic tokens meet documented contrast; final brand inputs can remap without changing meaning.
Keyboard, focus, labels, error association, disabled/pending states, target size, and reduced motion pass component tests.
Components distinguish requested/processing/final/failed/uncertain states and never infer provider or custody completion.
Public and private navigation follow Part 4; route visibility does not grant action authority; responsive/reflow pass.
No universal dashboard; direct deep links enforce server access; data density and touch behaviour match each surface.
All pilot components expose loading/empty/error/pending/disabled/permission states; baseline changes require review.
One User identity supports multiple memberships; tokens are hashed/one-time/expiring; sessions are revocable and device-visible.
No password/OTP/token logging; session rotates after login; concurrent revoke blocks future requests; direct API tests pass.
Email delivery is not verification truth; duplicate/expired token fails safely; recovery revokes relevant sessions.
Privileged roles cannot use protected surfaces without MFA; sensitive actions reject stale assurance; recovery cannot silently remove controls.
No global role grants unbounded access; one identity may combine approved roles; revoked/expired grants fail immediately.
Deny-by-default; every protected API uses policy middleware/application guard; hidden UI is not a control.
Seller, rider, buyer, Support, Finance, Trust, and Admin views expose only necessary fields; errors do not leak restricted reasons.
Money, access, enforcement, evidence access, configuration, and emergency actions are auditable; ordinary admins cannot edit/delete events.
Maker cannot self-approve high-risk grant; scope/expiry required; revocation invalidates active authority and sessions where required.
User can revoke other sessions; sensitive changes require step-up; truthful pending/failed states and accessible recovery work.
No Covenant email or matric pattern is hardcoded without configured approval; institution scope is present on protected records.
Straightforward cases can approve; duplicate/conflict never silently merges; affiliation is independent from seller/payout/trust status.
Evidence is private, least-privilege, time-limited, and not visible to sellers/riders; decision preserves history and reason.
Expired affiliation removes campus checkout without deleting account/history; stale sessions cannot retain capability.
Only approved active points are selectable; private room data is not exposed; all times use Africa/Lagos policy.
Closure blocks new commitments but preserves in-flight obligations; changes are audited and conflict-safe.
Seller type is not a global role; application approval and activation are distinct; agreements are versioned.
Applicant sees truthful status and missing actions; private evidence uses Files policy; no public store before activation.
No public external registration; invitation alone does not activate checkout or inbound logistics.
Reviewer authority is scoped; decision is auditable; approved seller remains inactive until readiness conditions pass.
Suspension blocks new commerce without losing paid-order obligations; no generic admin status edit.
Rider capability is institution-scoped and independent from buyer/seller roles; sensitive data is limited.
Expired/off-shift rider cannot accept assignments; override is reasoned and audited; Wi-Fi-first operation supported.
Dispatcher sees only assigned/eligible jobs and cannot access buyer private location, payments, seller ledger, or admin controls.
Category-specific fields replace giant nullable product table; disabled commerce types cannot create live listings.
Canonical product is seller-independent; duplicate suggestions require human approval; existing order snapshots are unaffected.
